name: business_days
description: Date arithmetic with weekends and holidays; needs fixed dates, not today().

mutants.name: Saturday counted
mutants.patch:
--- a/delivery/calendar.py
+++ b/delivery/calendar.py
@@ -1 +1 @@
-        if current.weekday() < 5 and current not in holidays:
+        if current.weekday() < 6 and current not in holidays:

mutants.name: holidays ignored
mutants.patch:
--- a/delivery/calendar.py
+++ b/delivery/calendar.py
@@ -1 +1 @@
-        if current.weekday() < 5 and current not in holidays:
+        if current.weekday() < 5:

mutants.name: negative days accepted
mutants.patch:
--- a/delivery/calendar.py
+++ b/delivery/calendar.py
@@ -1 +1 @@
-    if days < 0:
+    if days < -1:
